experiment: Build A/B — same app (Debrief MVP) built twice from EvanBacon/chat-template; one agent read the mobile-ux skills first, one didn't.
verification: All signals below were read directly from the generated code, not taken from the agents' self-reports.

without_skills.typecheck: pass (1 pre-existing template CSS error; 4 pre-existing template lint errors left in place)

verified_differentiators.axis: in-app appearance toggle (foundations non-negotiable: ship NONE)
verified_differentiators.without_skills: BUILT the anti-pattern — src/app/(app)/appearance.tsx ships a System/Light/Dark override via settings-context setAppearance
verified_differentiators.with_skills: AVOIDED it — src/app/settings/appearance.tsx ships no toggle, follows the system, footer points to iOS Settings; code comment cites mobile-ux-foundations
verified_differentiators.verdict: skill win (reproduces the fitstake ThemeToggle finding in a clean build)

verified_differentiators.axis: permission denied-state at point of use (permissions skill)
verified_differentiators.without_skills: DEAD-END — components/ui/voice-recorder.tsx:49 `if (!perm.granted) return;` silently does nothing on mic denial
verified_differentiators.with_skills: HANDLED — voice-recorder.tsx shows an Alert with 'Open Settings' (Linking.openSettings) on iOS and just 'OK' on Android — even encodes the iOS-vs-Android denial divergence from the skill

verified_differentiators.axis: paywall price disclosure (show the real charged total, not only monthly)
verified_differentiators.without_skills: shows a single p.price per plan
verified_differentiators.with_skills: shows billedAs (e.g. annual total) AND a secondary per-month equivalent + plan title

ties_baseline_already_strong: System Sign in with Apple button (BOTH used AppleAuthentication.AppleAuthenticationButton, not a custom one)
In-app account deletion that truly deletes local data (both)
Visible sign-in error (both Alert on failure — no swallow)
Restore Purchases + Terms + Privacy links on the paywall (both)
Permissions requested in context, not at launch (both)
other_notes: with-skills is leaner (37 src files) and cleared the template's pre-existing lint/tsc errors by removing dead chat/markdown/drawer clusters; without-skills kept more scaffolding (62 files) and left the pre-existing template errors.
with-skills BUILD-NOTES.md maps each feature to the skill guidance applied; without-skills BUILD-NOTES cites App Store rules from its own knowledge.
